inherited.M01: Training data come from the same prompted word-reading runs that are tested; no separate training-time action.
inherited.M02: No training-only signal beyond the labels; microphone audio is used to place phoneme onsets (M11), not as a regression target.
inherited.M04: Overt reading aloud of prompted monosyllabic words (Modified Rhyme Test plus 20 words).
inherited.M05: Clinical subdural ECoG grids with coverage set by medical need; high-gamma, mu, beta and local motor potential features, the Slutzky/Flint motor-decoding feature lineage.
inherited.M07: No language model; an optional closed stimulus-list constraint for whole-word identification.
inherited.M08: Phoneme class label; whole words only as concatenated phoneme predictions.
inherited.M09: Offline study: no presentation or confirmation step.
inherited.M13: Bedside epilepsy-monitoring recordings, offline analysis, no released code; ITR is a hypothetical estimate.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger text names an intracranial signal (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical, Utah array) together with phonemes, vowels, consonants or syllables (the population of the published topic intracranial-speech-unit-classification); the design of interest is the size of the speech-unit class set: the full phoneme inventory of a language (all phonemes, 38-44 classes) versus a small subset of two to six phonemes, vowels or syllables. Boundary: listening-only, mapping-only and review papers matched by the pattern stay in the count (upper bound); a study counts under every design its full text names; versions of one study count once; usual approach judged on studies first public before 2013-11 (more than six months before the target).
topics.metric: Phoneme classification accuracy over the full inventory against chance.

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept: intracranial speech or language decoding studies; the design of interest is how test data are separated from training data (random trial split, k-fold cross-validation, held-out session or day, held-out subject). This review adds a prior-time tally (index year up to 2013) under prior_tally_<slug>.

notes: M03 (feature-count tuning and peak-electrode selection), M11 (manually labelled phoneme onsets from the microphone, used for test trials too) are judged from the target's own text without an audit; their table counts are null. Inherited slots carry null counts.
prep_used: No prep directory existed; plan, audits and comparator reading built from scratch. Prior entries for Pei 2011, Leuthardt 2011 and Brumberg 2011 reused from the verified notes of the published Pei 2011 review.
